text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't think! Close your eyes! Just go for 
it! Whatever happens, happenzzzzz!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ALLLRIIIGHTTTTT, I'M SO HYPED UP---!!

Running with pure emotion, Mejiro Palmer 
crossed the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it worked! I totally did it! Once 
I went in with my mind completely blank!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks...! Back when I was obsessing over 
being serious, no matter how hard I tried, 
I just couldn't reach it at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she met her besties and learned 
how to goof off, she's changed this 
much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, I'm so stupid!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're way too clumsy, honestly... 
Ahahaha...

I praise Mejiro Palmer, who is laughing 
through her tears. Even if she'd played it 
by ear, it was a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, and here I thought Ines Fujin 
was gonna go wire-to-wire..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought Mejiro Ryan was gonna 
surge from behind and take it. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seems like some people really didn't 
see that coming after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, wasn't really the case for me, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run, Palmer-chan. 
So, as a special treat!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll do a special cheer call for you. 
Though honestly, I kind of wanted one done 
for me instead.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Here we go, ready, set!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ines... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even Ryan... Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks. It might not be a chant 
that goes down in Umamusume history, but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This will stay with me forever, you know?

It was a modest victory celebration with 
just the four of them.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see☆ Ines's run today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Assuming I do that, then my bestie will 
run away too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just had a flash of inspiration for 
a totally killer move, ya know?☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It's a God-tier plan, but probs zero 
chance♪ More importantly, come on, let's 
get back to chilling out!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shake up this soda pop☆, pop the cap, and 
inside—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mantis Caller ★★★ Fooooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh, isn't that bad?! Oh no... 
Gyaaaah!!

And so, the foam party celebrating a job 
well done at the Derby went on late into 
the night.
